bugs.title: Recent hazard panel omits seeded Engineering Hall hazard
bugs.evidence: Browser check saferoute-metrics-and-hazards-visible failed twice after rerun: recent-hazards-panel rendered only the newest five Arts Center rows and did not contain Engineering Hall or the seeded description. Backend cross-check GET /api/safety/dashboard returned 200 with metrics and recent_hazards, but its newest five rows were also all Arts Center tscheck fixtures, so the UI/API are consistent; the criterion's seeded-row assertion is not stable after accumulated test data.

action_items: Review dashboard recent-hazard ordering/fixture isolation: the check's seeded Engineering Hall expectation is displaced by newer tscheck rows after prior runs. Prefer asserting on a hazard created by the check or ensure seeded/demo rows remain visible.
The initial emergency confirmation issue is resolved: saferoute-dispatches-emergency passed on retest and backend dispatch tests pass.
